subject: Post-call: Invoice & procurement path - Redwood for Acme Energy
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jessica Li <jessica.li@acme-energy.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme-energy.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Invoice & procurement path - Redwood for Acme Energy

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so procurement has what you need to move a pilot forward:

Summary of what we discussed:
- Procurement path: Acme prefers a PO'd flow (we discussed PO + Net 30) but also wanted confirmation on a card-based option if you need to start sooner.
- Marketplace: you asked whether Redwood is on AWS Marketplace. We are not yet listed; plan is targeted for Q4 2026. If Marketplace is required, we can discuss timeline and alternatives.
- Invoice requirements: you asked for W-9, remit-to/billing address, tax / VAT handling, invoice format (CSV/Excel/PDF), and whether we can include a PO number on invoice lines.

Action items / next steps:
1) Jessica / Procurement: confirm whether Acme will raise a PO (and expected timing) or if a card will be used for the initial month. Please share the exact billing address and tax ID to appear on the invoice.
2) We (Redwood): I will attach our W-9 and a proforma invoice template for your billing ops to validate. If you have a required invoice template, please send it back to me and our finance team will align.
3) Internal: looping in David (cc) to prepare the proforma with both PO and card flows plus Net 30 terms.

Notes on terms we can accommodate:
- Standard: Net 30 on PO'd invoices for enterprise purchases (we can consider Net 45 for committed annual contracts with finance approval).
- Card: immediate charge with receipt/invoice generated same day.
- Tax/VAT: for US entities, standard US tax rules apply; for EU subsidiaries we will include VAT details on the invoice when a VAT number is provided.

Attachments: Redwood_W9.pdf, Proforma_Invoice_Template.xlsx.

If helpful I can schedule a 15-min call between our finance lead and your billing ops to close the format and remit-to details.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform

From: Jessica Li <jessica.li@acme-energy.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <t.reynolds@acme-energy.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme-energy.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:04:32 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Invoice & procurement path - Redwood for Acme Energy

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from procurement:

1) We will be going the PO route for the pilot. Expect a PO to be raised once we have a final quote and W-9 on file. Our standard terms are Net 30; exceptions require legal approval.
2) Billing address (for invoicing and tax):
   Acme Energy, Inc.
   Attn: Accounts Payable
   400 Harbor Drive
   San Francisco, CA 94105
3) Tax ID: 12-3456789
4) Invoice format: XLSX or PDF is fine. Please include separate line items with description, quantity, unit price, and total.
5) PO number must appear on the invoice header and each line item when provided.
6) Marketplace: preferred but not required for pilot. If Redwood will be on AWS Marketplace in Q4, we can evaluate moving to that for renewal but not required to start.

Can you email your W-9 and the proforma invoice template (please populate with the pilot pricing line item we discussed) so our billing ops can validate? I’ll loop Tom (procurement) to confirm internal PO timing — Tom, any estimate on when we can issue the PO after we receive the completed proforma and W-9?

Thanks,
Jessica Li
Director, Cloud Platforms | Acme Energy
jessica.li@acme-energy.com
(415) 222-9087

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jessica Li <jessica.li@acme-energy.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme-energy.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 14:20:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Invoice & procurement path - Redwood for Acme Energy

Thanks Jessica — attaching the W-9 and a populated proforma invoice for the pilot (attachment stub: Proforma_Invoice_Template.xlsx). Key notes included in the proforma:
- Pilot line item labeled: "Redwood Inference - Pilot (100k tokens)" with unit price and estimated total.
- Invoice header includes fields for PO number, billing address, and tax ID.
- Payment terms set to Net 30 for PO flow.

Quick answers to the questions you raised:
- We accept PO with Net 30 (standard). If your AP team needs a different net term, we can escalate to finance but Net 30 is typical.
- Card option: we can enable immediate access using a company card; we will send a card receipt and invoice same day.
- Marketplace: not live on AWS Marketplace yet; expected Q4 2026. We can revisit for renewals.
- VAT: if you provide a VAT number for an EU entity, we will include the VAT section on the invoice and follow local requirements.

Remit-to / Billing details for Acme to validate against their AP system:
Redwood Inference, Inc.
Attn: Accounts Receivable
PO Box 2409
San Francisco, CA 94126
EIN: 98-7654321

If this looks good, I can have our finance manager send a formal invoice once the PO is issued. Let me know if procurement would like a 15-min sync — happy to schedule.

Attachments (stubs): Redwood_W9.pdf; Proforma_Invoice_Template.xlsx; Redwood_Standard_Terms.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Tom Reynolds <t.reynolds@acme-energy.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jessica Li <jessica.li@acme-energy.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme-energy.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 08:37:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Invoice & procurement path - Redwood for Acme Energy

Marissa — received, thank you. We reviewed the proforma and W-9. A couple quick asks from AP before we issue PO:
- Can you include the vendor remit-to email on the invoice (ap@redwoodinference.com) and a contact name for questions?
- Please ensure the proforma includes a single-line description and a separate tax/VAT field (if applicable).
- For our internal routing, please include your Redwood vendor number if you have one (if not, leave blank and we will create one).

Assuming those are present we should be able to issue the PO within 3-5 business days. We prefer PO + Net 30.

Tom
